What are digital wedding invitations?

Digital wedding invitations are online invitations you send by link, text or email instead of by mail. Guests open a page on their phone with your names, the ceremony and reception details, a map and an RSVP button. With MyInviteQR every invitation also gets its own QR code, so you can put the same invitation on a printed save-the-date, a program or a welcome sign.

Couples in the United States choose digital invitations because they are faster to send, cheaper than printing and postage, and far easier to keep accurate. If the venue, the time or the dress code changes, you edit the invitation once and every guest sees the update. Replies arrive in one guest list, so you always know your headcount for the caterer.

Tips for sending digital wedding invitations

  • Send save-the-dates 6 to 9 months out and the full invitation 6 to 8 weeks before the wedding.
  • Add a reply-by date so you have a final headcount at least three weeks before the day.
  • Put your QR code on the printed save-the-date so older guests can scan instead of typing a link.
  • Use groups (family, friends, wedding party) to keep the guest list organized.
  • Send a personal link to each guest with Premium so you can see who has opened it.

Wedding invitation questions

When should I send digital wedding invitations?

Send save-the-dates 6 to 9 months before the wedding and the full invitation 6 to 8 weeks before. Digital invitations let you send them whenever you are ready.

Can I use MyInviteQR for both the save-the-date and the invitation?

Yes. Publish one invitation and update it as your plans firm up. The same link and QR code keep working, and guests always see the latest details.

How many wedding guests can I invite?

Essential supports up to 50 guests. Premium supports up to 1,000, which covers almost any wedding.

Are digital wedding invitations acceptable etiquette?

Yes. Digital invitations are widely accepted, especially for casual and modern weddings. Many couples pair them with a printed card for close family.

Can I add a wedding website link or registry?

Yes. Add text or a link anywhere on your invitation with the editor, for example your registry or accommodation details.

Can guests RSVP for a plus one or their family?

Yes. Guests choose yes, no or maybe and enter the number of people in their party.

Can I print my digital wedding invitation?

You can download the QR code and add it to printed cards. Many couples send a printed card to close family and the digital invitation to everyone else.
